panels.title: Turn p50
panels.description: Half of the customer turns finished within this time.

panels.title: Turn p95
panels.description: 95% of the customer turns finished within this time.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) ((last_over_time(retail_turn_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", turn_kind="chat"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(retail_turn_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", turn_kind="chat"}[$__range] offset $__range) or last_over_time(retail_turn_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", turn_kind="chat"}[$__range]) * 0))))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) ((last_over_time(retail_turn_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", turn_kind="confirm"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(retail_turn_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", turn_kind="confirm"}[$__range] offset $__range) or last_over_time(retail_turn_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", turn_kind="confirm"}[$__range]) * 0))))

panels.title: Step p50
panels.description: Time spent in each step of a turn.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, step) ((last_over_time(retail_step_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(retail_step_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job"}[$__range] offset $__range) or last_over_time(retail_step_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) * 0))))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, step) ((last_over_time(retail_step_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(retail_step_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job"}[$__range] offset $__range) or last_over_time(retail_step_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) * 0))))

panels.title: CPU p50
panels.description: Whole machine, sampled every 5 s while the API runs.

panels.title: RAM by component
panels.description: The API, the model server and the MCP server.

targets.expr: sum ((last_over_time(retail_llm_tokens_sum{job=~"$job", token_type="input"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(retail_llm_tokens_sum{job=~"$job", token_type="input"}[$__range] offset $__range) or last_over_time(retail_llm_tokens_sum{job=~"$job", token_type="input"}[$__range]) * 0))) or vector(0)

sum ((last_over_time(retail_llm_tokens_sum{job=~"$job", token_type="output"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(retail_llm_tokens_sum{job=~"$job", token_type="output"}[$__range] offset $__range) or last_over_time(retail_llm_tokens_sum{job=~"$job", token_type="output"}[$__range]) * 0))) or vector(0)

sum ((last_over_time(retail_llm_tokens_sum{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(retail_llm_tokens_sum{job=~"$job"}[$__range] offset $__range) or last_over_time(retail_llm_tokens_sum{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) * 0))) / sum ((last_over_time(retail_turn_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(retail_turn_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job"}[$__range] offset $__range) or last_over_time(retail_turn_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) * 0)))

panels.title: Output tokens/s p50
panels.description: Output tokens divided by the whole call's time, not raw decode speed.

targets.expr: sum ((last_over_time(retail_llm_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(retail_llm_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job"}[$__range] offset $__range) or last_over_time(retail_llm_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) * 0))) / sum ((last_over_time(retail_turn_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(retail_turn_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job"}[$__range] offset $__range) or last_over_time(retail_turn_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) * 0)))

panels.title: Tool calls
panels.description: Calls the Retail Operations Agent asked for.

targets.expr: sum ((last_over_time(retail_tool_calls_total{job=~"$job", outcome="failed"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(retail_tool_calls_total{job=~"$job", outcome="failed"}[$__range] offset $__range) or last_over_time(retail_tool_calls_total{job=~"$job", outcome="failed"}[$__range]) * 0))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Refused
panels.description: The model asked for something outside the allowlist.

targets.expr: sum ((last_over_time(retail_tool_calls_total{job=~"$job", outcome="refused"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(retail_tool_calls_total{job=~"$job", outcome="refused"}[$__range] offset $__range) or last_over_time(retail_tool_calls_total{job=~"$job", outcome="refused"}[$__range]) * 0))) or vector(0)

panels.title: MCP connect p95
panels.description: Connecting to the MCP server, once per request.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, tool_name) ((last_over_time(retail_tool_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(retail_tool_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job"}[$__range] offset $__range) or last_over_time(retail_tool_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job"}[$__range]) * 0))))

sum ((last_over_time(retail_turn_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", decision="error"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(retail_turn_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", decision="error"}[$__range] offset $__range) or last_over_time(retail_turn_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", decision="error"}[$__range]) * 0))) or vector(0)

sum ((last_over_time(retail_llm_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", outcome="error"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(retail_llm_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", outcome="error"}[$__range] offset $__range) or last_over_time(retail_llm_call_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", outcome="error"}[$__range]) * 0))) or vector(0)

sum ((last_over_time(retail_tool_calls_total{job=~"$job", outcome="failed"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(retail_tool_calls_total{job=~"$job", outcome="failed"}[$__range] offset $__range) or last_over_time(retail_tool_calls_total{job=~"$job", outcome="failed"}[$__range]) * 0))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Guardrail blocks
panels.description: Input or replies the guardrails stopped. These are often correct behaviour.

targets.expr: sum ((last_over_time(retail_guardrail_checks_total{job=~"$job", outcome="blocked"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(retail_guardrail_checks_total{job=~"$job", outcome="blocked"}[$__range] offset $__range) or last_over_time(retail_guardrail_checks_total{job=~"$job", outcome="blocked"}[$__range]) * 0))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Timeouts recovered
panels.description: A commit saved, its reply was lost, and the result was read back. Nothing was committed twice.

targets.expr: sum ((last_over_time(retail_business_outcomes_total{job=~"$job", outcome="reconciled"}[$__range]) - (last_over_time(retail_business_outcomes_total{job=~"$job", outcome="reconciled"}[$__range] offset $__range) or last_over_time(retail_business_outcomes_total{job=~"$job", outcome="reconciled"}[$__range]) * 0))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Requests that failed
panels.description: Click a request to see its steps, inputs, outputs and times.

targets.query: {resource.service.name="hp-retail-agentic-ai" && name="retail.customer_turn" && span.retail.decision="error"} | select(span.retail.decision, span.retail.turn.kind, span.retail.content.query, span.retail.content.answer)

panels.title: Recent requests: click one to see its steps
panels.description: Every customer turn. Click a request to see its steps, inputs, outputs and times.
